name: 91326 · Porter Ranch, CA
findings: ZIP 91326 (Porter Ranch) has 138 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91326 (Porter Ranch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
